nameEn: Electric power generation, transmission and distribution
description: This class includes the generation of bulk electric power, and its transmission and distribution to end users.
includes: operation of electric power generation facilities: thermal, nuclear, hydroelectric, wind, solar, geothermal, tidal
operation of electricity transmission systems (high-voltage lines)
operation of electricity distribution systems (medium and low-voltage lines)
sale of electricity to households, industrial and commercial users
operation of electric power substations and switching stations
excludes: production of electricity by industrial enterprises for own consumption, classified in the originating class
